learning_objectives: Given a list of AI uses in an investment firm, classify which uses fall within the article's stated retail-investment-services scope and cite the relevant section of AR-000310.

Identify the three MiFID II duty areas highlighted in AR-000310—organisational requirements, conduct of business, and acting in the client's best interests—without treating ESMA's statement as a new standalone AI rule.
From a short AI deployment scenario, identify at least four risks named in AR-000310, choosing from algorithmic bias, data quality, opacity, overreliance, privacy, and security concerns.

Build an evidence checklist that maps an AI-supported investment-service step to an accountable owner, data/output validation, human escalation, and retained compliance evidence, marking each item as FACT-derived or ANALYSIS-derived from AR-000310.
Evaluate a vendor-assurance scenario and explain, using AR-000310's Common mistakes section, why a vendor statement does not replace the investment firm's own compliance evidence.
Distinguish factual regulatory statements from AGNUS analysis by correctly labeling five statements drawn from AR-000310 and tracing each FACT statement to its cited source locator.
Produce a one-page control-gap assessment for a hypothetical AI-supported suitability workflow and state which conclusions cannot be reached from AR-000310 alone.
